messages.content: United changed our Sunday flight. It now leaves Seattle close to 3:15 and lands after 10:30. Check whether we can move all three of us earlier without paying a ridiculous amount.

I found the schedule change on confirmation H7LM2Q. United 2216 now departs SEA Sunday, November 30, at 3:12 p.m. and arrives ORD at 10:41 p.m. Because the change is airline-initiated, United is offering a one-time move to another United nonstop that day without a change fee. I’ll check three-seat availability and any fare difference.
Compare it with the earlier nonstops. The Wednesday flight and the airport hotel stay as they are.

There are two earlier United nonstops with three economy seats available. The 9:35 a.m. departure arrives ORD at 3:32 p.m. and can be selected at no additional charge. The 11:50 a.m. departure arrives at 5:48 p.m. and adds $174 total for the three travelers. Your changed 3:12 p.m. flight remains valid at no added cost.
What does each one mean for getting home? Include the checked bag and a rideshare from O’Hare.

For the 9:35 flight, plan to reach SEA by about 7:35 a.m.; after landing, baggage claim and a rideshare should put you home around 4:50 to 5:15 p.m. The 11:50 flight means arriving at SEA around 9:50 a.m. and getting home around 7:05 to 7:30 p.m. Keeping the changed flight would likely mean leaving ORD around 11:25 p.m. and reaching home between midnight and 12:25 a.m., with some risk of a later arrival if Sunday traffic or baggage delivery runs slowly.
That last one is too late with school and work Monday. Are the three seats together on either earlier flight?
The 9:35 flight has three adjacent seats in row 27, but they are near the back. The 11:50 flight has 22D, 22E, and 22F together. Your checked-bag allowance transfers to either option.
The 9:35 is earlier than I’d like for the last morning with family. Is the $174 the full additional amount, not per person?
Correct. It is $174 total, or $58 per traveler, for the 11:50 a.m. flight. There is no separate ticket-change fee, and the existing checked bag remains included.
Put the 11:50 ahead of the 9:35. I prefer a morning departure when the schedule doesn’t force something else, and this one still gives us a reasonable Sunday morning without wrecking Monday.

The 11:50 option is the better balance: SEA 11:50 a.m. to ORD 5:48 p.m., three seats together, and an estimated home arrival before 7:30 p.m. The additional charge is $174 total. The Wednesday American flight and Coast Gateway Hotel reservation will not be affected.
Go ahead and change all three tickets to that flight. Keep the seats together and use the payment method on file for the difference.

Before submission: this will replace the changed 3:12 p.m. return for Marcus, Daniel, and Owen with United 1847 on Sunday, November 30, SEA 11:50 a.m. to ORD 5:48 p.m. Seats 22D, 22E, and 22F are selected, the checked bag is preserved, and $174 will be charged to the saved card. Shall I submit it?

Completed. United confirmation H7LM2Q now shows United 1847 on Sunday, November 30, departing SEA at 11:50 a.m. and arriving ORD at 5:48 p.m. for Marcus, Daniel, and Owen. Seats 22D, 22E, and 22F are confirmed, and the checked bag remains included. The card on file was charged $174 total. Plan to leave the relatives’ home in time to reach SEA by about 9:50 a.m.; after landing in Chicago, baggage claim and a rideshare should put you home around 7:05 to 7:30 p.m. The Wednesday American outbound and Coast Gateway Hotel reservation are unchanged.
